entries.title: Toward a Survey-Agnostic Census of Temporary Stellar Non-Detection
entries.short_title: Stellar Wink Census: rate statistics and observational tests
entries.originator: Research draft prepared for Nathan McKnight (coauthors TBD)
entries.summary: A survey-agnostic protocol for quantifying temporary source nondetections, event rates, durations, detection efficiencies, and multi-mechanism diagnostics; with 17-hypothesis evidence matrix.
entries.caveat: Methodology draft only. No observed wink rate or evidence for any speculative cosmological mechanism. Requires domain review before scientific submission.

entries.title: Projected Toroidal Geometry and Testable Angular Statistics for Transient Stellar Visibility
entries.short_title: Cruller sky-projection and Rubin visibility test
entries.summary: Exact off-axis projection of a toroidal inner ring, a gravitational lens image-count counterexample, and a survey-mask-aware preregistered search design for apparent stellar disappearance and return.
entries.caveat: No star detections or validated cosmological model; illustrative angles, geometry, rates and significance are not physical forecasts. Requires independent review. Feed stage is not live-site publication.

addenda.title: Addendum 01: Angular–temporal correlations in hypothetical stellar noise
addenda.summary: Frozen-screen covariance, temporal power spectrum, cross-star lag prediction and numerical angular coherence at 1–1000 pc. Conditional test only, not measured Rubin evidence.

addenda.title: Addendum 02: Translating-screen versus coherent stellar-noise correlations
addenda.summary: Cross-star delay ridges distinguish conditional moving-screen and simultaneous common-mode models; scale example and selection controls.

addenda.title: Addendum 03: Rotational noise correlations and chirality identification
addenda.summary: Signed time-lag covariance distinguishes clockwise and counterclockwise toy advection; requires oriented observer-frame calibration and control for systematic rotational patterns.

addenda.title: Addendum 04: Forest statistical midpoint and S³ projection null
addenda.summary: Exact 4D isotropic-hemisphere projection statistics: mean 4/(3pi), variance 1/4-16/(9pi²); distinguishes path speed c from mean radial projection and statistical midpoint.

addenda.title: Addendum 05: Known-physics stellar-wink duration distributions
addenda.summary: Existing dust-extinction physics and exact chord geometry predict the conditional stellar-wink duration CDF, mean duration, event-rate/covering-fraction relation and survey-cadence detection bias; explicitly not a Cruller prediction.

addenda.title: Addendum 06: Audit of NLM's Stellar-Wink Experimental Discriminators
addenda.summary: Separates validated lensing, extinction, and survey tests from unsupported 0.246-rad and 80% blackout claims; corrects fold-caustic signs and shows odd-lag covariance occurs for nonrotating drift.

entries.title: A Direct Search for Weak Secondary Emission from Controlled Boundary-Passage Experiments
entries.summary: A parameterized family of differential searches for rare detector-level secondary events near controlled boundaries. The proposed search can yield a useful null bound without assuming SAT/H(s)H's speculative mechanism.
entries.caveat: No demonstrated apparatus sensitivity, particle identity, derived emission mechanism, or experimental result is claimed.

entries.title: Convergent Geometric Motifs in Recent Fundamental Physics: A Minkowski-First Comparison with Scalar--Angular--Torsion (SAT)
entries.summary: A provenance-sensitive Minkowski-first comparison of selected contemporary geometric motifs with the documented SAT lineage, including explicit tests for object-level correspondence, dimensional reduction, holonomy, emergent discreteness, and benchmark failure.
entries.caveat: Accepted under the current internal Grurple review/provenance gates; not scientific validation, novelty clearance, PRIOR_ART clearance, or external peer review.
